entries.note: Pressurised hydroponic shed: ribbed steel roof split by two lit grow-light skylights over crop racks, roof fans, airlock west, pipes on the south eave. Covered farm on a hostile world; walk-in, no cover.
The hydroponic shed half as long, to end a row or fill a short plot.
Pump house: water and nutrient tanks, pump and header pipe on a skid, ending a shed row.

note: A covered farm look for hostile worlds (story-map-pools.md, Planet skin; PlanetSkin.FarmLook), one of three put to the owner after the polytunnels did not read as hydroponics. Measured 1448x1086 RGBA, three alpha pieces. Geometry-first reskin of templates/hydro-sheds-guide.png (hydroponics-guide.py, 160 px a cell); ImageGen returned the sheet uniformly at 0.943 of the guide and every piece within a few pixels of its guide, so each rect is its guide frame at that scale. Exact prompt in hydro-sheds.prompt.txt.
